commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
for tool_name in python3 python perl ruby node gdb gdbserver lldb strace dotnet csi dbus-send gdbus; do
 echo "TOOL_LOOKUP $tool_name"
 command -v "$tool_name"
 tool_lookup_exit=$?
 echo "TOOL_LOOKUP_EXIT $tool_lookup_exit"
done
date -u
